output.reason: The validators confirm from the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install manifests [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] that `status.artifact.digest` is now required in the OCIRepository v1beta2 schema. A nested required field is listed in its parent's `required` list, so it is only enforced when `status.artifact` is present. The proposed condition only checks that `digest` is unset. That also flags OCIRepositories with no status artifact at all, which are not rejected, so it is too broad. The exposure should require `status.artifact` to be set and `status.artifact.digest` to be unset, as P2 and P3 propose. The excerpts themselves are thin, so confidence is low.

correction.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 OCIRepository schema, status.artifact.digest is now required. OCIRepository objects whose status.artifact has no digest are rejected.
